T: A boy's best friend is his mother. A guest's best friend is supper.
D: A thief on the run checks into a remote motel run by a troubled young man.
P: Serve the sandwiches when Norman brings Marion supper in the parlour.
S: ham and cheese on white, under the stuffed birds
Leg ham and Swiss on buttered white bread with mustard, crusts off, cut into neat triangles, milk on the side.
from the house on the hill
Small onions peeled, brined overnight, packed in hot spiced vinegar with sugar and peppercorns, pickled a week.
M: for Marion's long drive in the rain
Chicken pieces brined in buttermilk, dredged and fried at 165C, served cold the next day the way you'd pack it for the car.
Chicken simmered in a creamy broth with vegetables and fluffy herb dumplings. Simmer 1kg chicken thighs with carrots, celery, onion and 1.5L stock for 30 minutes, shred the meat and add 100ml cream.
W: white, swirly and hard to look at
Swiss meringue piped into tall swirls, baked at 100C for 90 minutes, cooled in the oven. Raspberry coulis drizzled over.
K: Norman pours one in the parlour
Cold full cream milk in a tall glass.

s.note: ham and cheese on white, under the stuffed birds
s.how: Butter 8 slices white bread and spread with Dijon. Fill with 200g sliced ham and 100g Swiss cheese. Cut off the crusts and cut into neat triangles. Serve on a plate with a glass of milk alongside.

s.note: from the house on the hill
s.how: Peel 500g pickling onions and soak in salted water overnight. Rinse and pack into a jar. Boil 500ml malt vinegar with 100g sugar and 1 tsp peppercorns and pour over hot. Seal and leave a week before eating.

m.how: Simmer 1kg chicken thighs with carrots, celery, onion and 1.5L stock for 30 minutes, shred the meat and add 100ml cream. Mix 200g self-raising flour, 40g butter, parsley and 150ml milk, drop spoonfuls on top, cover and cook 15 minutes.

w.note: white, swirly and hard to look at
w.how: Whisk 3 egg whites and 180g sugar over simmering water until hot, then beat to stiff peaks. Pipe tall swirls and bake at 100C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Blitz 200g raspberries with lemon juice and sugar and drizzle over.

d.note: Norman pours one in the parlour
d.how: Chill 1L full cream milk in the coldest part of the fridge. Pour into four tall glasses and serve. A boy's best friend is his mother, and a glass of milk goes well with sandwiches.
